events.title: Death of Cleopatra
events.description: The last Pharaoh of Ancient Egypt died, marking the end of the Ptolemaic Kingdom.

events.title: Fire of Rome
events.description: The Great Fire of Rome destroyed much of the city during the reign of Emperor Nero.

events.title: Eruption of Mount Vesuvius
events.description: The eruption of Mount Vesuvius buried the Roman cities of Pompeii and Herculaneum.

events.title: Council of Nicaea
events.description: The First Council of Nicaea was held, establishing the Nicene Creed.

events.title: Fall of the Western Roman Empire
events.description: Romulus Augustulus was deposed, marking the traditional end of the Western Roman Empire.

events.title: Hijra of Muhammad
events.description: The journey of the Islamic prophet Muhammad and his followers from Mecca to Medina.

events.title: Battle of Tours
events.description: Charles Martel defeated the Umayyad Caliphate, halting the Muslim advance into Europe.

events.title: Coronation of Charlemagne
events.description: Charlemagne was crowned Holy Roman Emperor by Pope Leo III.

events.title: Battle of Hastings
events.description: William the Conqueror defeated King Harold II, leading to the Norman conquest of England.

events.title: Signing of the Magna Carta
events.description: King John of England was forced to sign the Great Charter, limiting royal power.

events.title: Marco Polo's Arrival in China
events.description: The Venetian explorer arrived at the court of Kublai Khan.

events.title: The Black Death
events.description: The bubonic plague reached Europe, eventually killing a significant portion of the population.

events.title: Fall of Constantinople
events.description: The Ottoman Empire captured the capital of the Byzantine Empire.

events.title: Columbus Reaches the Americas
events.description: Christopher Columbus landed in the Caribbean, opening the era of European exploration.

events.title: Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa
events.description: The famous portrait was begun in Florence.

events.title: Martin Luther's 95 Theses
events.description: The Protestant Reformation began with the posting of these theses in Wittenberg.

events.title: Magellan's Circumnavigation
events.description: The expedition led by Ferdinand Magellan completed the first circumnavigation of the globe.

events.title: Elizabeth I becomes Queen
events.description: The Elizabethan Era began, a golden age for England.

events.title: Shakespeare's First Folio
events.description: The first collected edition of William Shakespeare's plays was published.

events.title: Great Fire of London
events.description: The massive fire destroyed much of the city of London.

events.title: Isaac Newton's Principia
events.description: Newton published his work on the laws of motion and universal gravitation.

events.title: Declaration of Independence
events.description: The United States declared its independence from Great Britain.

events.title: French Revolution Begins
events.description: The storming of the Bastille marked the start of the revolution in France.

events.title: Napoleon's Defeat at Waterloo
events.description: The final defeat of Napoleon Bonaparte ended the Napoleonic Wars.

events.title: Battle of Gettysburg
events.description: A turning point in the American Civil War.

events.title: Opening of the Suez Canal
events.description: The canal connecting the Mediterranean and Red Seas was opened.

events.title: World War I Begins
events.description: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand triggered the Great War.

events.title: Russian Revolution
events.description: The Bolsheviks led by Lenin seized power in Russia.

events.title: The Great Depression Begins
events.description: The stock market crash in October marked the start of the economic crisis.

events.title: World War II Begins
events.description: Germany invaded Poland, leading to the start of the second world war.

events.title: Hiroshima and Nagasaki Bombings
events.description: The first and only use of atomic weapons in warfare.

events.title: Founding of the United Nations
events.description: The international organization was established to maintain peace and security.

events.title: Indian Independence
events.description: India gained independence from British rule.

events.title: Founding of the People's Republic of China
events.description: Mao Zedong proclaimed the founding of the new state.

events.title: Korean War Begins
events.description: The conflict between North and South Korea began.

events.title: Sputnik 1 Launch
events.description: The Soviet Union launched the first artificial satellite into orbit.

events.title: Cuban Missile Crisis
events.description: A 13-day confrontation between the US and the Soviet Union.

events.title: Assassination of JFK
events.description: President John F. Kennedy was assassinated in Dallas, Texas.

events.title: Apollo 11 Moon Landing
events.description: Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin became the first humans to walk on the moon.

events.title: Fall of the Berlin Wall
events.description: The wall separating East and West Berlin was opened, symbolizing the end of the Cold War.

events.title: Nelson Mandela Released
events.description: The anti-apartheid leader was released after 27 years in prison.

events.title: Dissolution of the Soviet Union
events.description: The USSR officially ceased to exist.

events.title: Founding of the World Wide Web
events.description: Tim Berners-Lee made the web publicly available.

events.title: 9/11 Attacks
events.description: Al-Qaeda launched terrorist attacks on the World Trade Center and Pentagon.

events.title: Invasion of Iraq
events.description: A US-led coalition invaded Iraq to remove Saddam Hussein.

events.title: Election of Barack Obama
events.description: The first African American President of the United States was elected.

events.title: Arab Spring
events.description: A wave of pro-democracy protests and uprisings across the Middle East.

events.title: Brexit Referendum
events.description: The UK voted to leave the European Union.

events.title: COVID-19 Pandemic Begins
events.description: The global outbreak of the SARS-CoV-2 virus was declared a pandemic.

events.title: Launch of James Webb Space Telescope
events.description: The most powerful space telescope ever built was launched into orbit.
